AP->SP is the range where glass changes from the viscoelastic state to a rigid state and stress can relax; slow cooling lets internal stress release along the temperature gradient, while fast cooling freezes thermal stress and causes later spontaneous cracking. The slow cooling rate is inversely proportional to the square of the thickness, so thicker glass cools more slowly.
